className.description: A string of all className you want applied to the base component.
className.name: className

closeButton.description: Automatically add a close button to the header.
closeButton.name: closeButton

closeLabel.description:
Overrides the close button's accessible name (defaults to `'Close'`). Set this for
non-English UIs.
closeLabel.name: closeLabel

component.description: Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component.
component.name: component

icon.description:
Leading icon. A string is an icon name, rendered like `<ToastIcon name={icon} />` (or by
`IconProvider`'s `component`) and hidden from
assistive technology by default, since it duplicates the heading visually. Pass any other
node for a fully custom icon (typically a logo or avatar) — a custom node is left as-is,
since it may carry its own meaningful accessible name (e.g. an avatar's `alt` text).
icon.name: icon

time.description: Trailing timestamp, rendered after the heading.
time.name: time

titleId.description:
Sets the `id` on the rendered heading element, for `aria-labelledby` wiring. Set
automatically by `Toast` when both `title` and `message` are used together; only needed
here for manual wiring in a fully custom composition.
titleId.name: titleId

asChild.description:
Render the single child element in place of this component's own element, with this
component's classes, props and ref merged onto it: `<Button asChild><Link href="/login">Log
in</Link></Button>`. The alternative to `component` for React Server Components — an element
can be passed from the server to this package's client components, a component reference
(`component={Link}`) can't.
asChild.name: asChild
